capabilities.label: Durable Work Queue
capabilities.summary: Route long-running, retryable, restart-sensitive, or auditable work through the durable workload lane instead of the live chat loop.

inputs.artifact_required: Boolean; true for substantial research/reference work

capabilities.outputs: Queued work item with durable id, status, liveness, owner, and closeout result.

use_when: Task is likely to take more than 3-5 minutes.
Task should survive a gateway/session restart.
Task has dependencies, needs retries, or needs audit history.
Operator may need pause, resume, cancel, replay, or status.
Substantial research/reference work must leave a markdown artifact.
avoid_when: The answer is a direct conversational response.
The task is a tiny one-shot lookup with no durable value.
closeout: Return durable id, state, owner, last meaningful event, result, and artifact path when present.
Do not close artifact-required work without artifact_path or explicit no_artifact_reason.

capabilities.label: GBrain Local Admin Via Minions
capabilities.summary: Run local-only GBrain admin operations through Minions shell jobs with inherited secrets, not through thin-client MCP or raw secret env.

inputs.cwd: Brain repo or gbrain workspace path
inputs.inherit: Config secret names such as database_url; never raw values

capabilities.outputs: Minions job id plus GBrain health/status result.
capabilities.cost_per_call: local runtime plus provider costs for embed/dream/remediate
requires_creds: gbrain worker config for inherited secrets when DB/provider access is needed

routing_policy.first_step: Run or queue a read-only doctor/status check when appropriate.
routing_policy.submission_rule: Use gbrain jobs submit shell with inherit for secrets; never persist raw DATABASE_URL or API keys in env.
routing_policy.worker_rule: Verify gbrain jobs supervisor status before assuming queued shell jobs will run.
direct_ok: Read-only MCP-equivalent operations such as search/query/get/list can run directly or through MCP.
minions_required_for: Any local-only op from a thin-client/control surface.
Any admin op that needs retry/audit history.

capabilities.label: Coding Worktree Lane
capabilities.summary: Route repo-writing coding tasks into an isolated worktree/branch with recorded gates, tests, diff base, and closeout artifacts.

inputs.acceptance_checks: Tests or manual checks required before closeout

capabilities.outputs: Coding run state with worktree path, branch, test results, gate verdicts, diff, and merge status.
capabilities.rate_limit: operator controlled; one worktree per writing task
requires_creds: Claude/Codex auth if delegated to coding CLI

routing_policy.isolation: Writing tasks require an isolated worktree/branch by default.
routing_policy.dirty_repo_rule: Do not edit a dirty shared repo unless the operator explicitly authorizes that exact working tree.

capabilities.label: Claude Code + gstack Specialist Lane
capabilities.summary: Use Claude Code with explicit gstack skill prompts for planning, review, QA, security, design, documentation, shipping, and investigation.

inputs.repo_or_url: Repository path, PR/branch context, or URL to QA

capabilities.outputs: Specialist output such as plan, findings, screenshots, test results, PR, or release notes.
capabilities.rate_limit: Claude Code/session limits and operator policy
requires_creds: gstack installed or curated gstack skill bundle available

routing_policy.launch_rule: Launch with an explicit skill prompt; do not vaguely ask Claude to help.
routing_policy.durability_rule: Long-running CLI sessions must register with the durable/background lane, not raw detached processes.
examples: Load gstack. Run /review on this repo. Return findings first with file/line references.
Load gstack. Run /qa https://... and capture screenshots for verified bugs.
Load gstack. Run /autoplan for this feature and save the plan; wait for approval before implementation.

capabilities.label: Local Inference Admission Gate
capabilities.summary: Bound Spark/local-model worker concurrency by measured capacity and meaningful liveness instead of launching unlimited agents.
capabilities.outputs: Queued or admitted local inference job with capacity state and liveness events.

routing_policy.admission_rule: Queue when capacity is saturated; do not equate more workers with more throughput.
routing_policy.liveness_rule: Distinguish waiting for capacity from stalled worker.

capabilities.label: Artifact-First Research
capabilities.summary: Substantial research/reference work should create a markdown artifact and return only a concise executive readout in chat.

inputs.sources: Known source constraints or topic context

capabilities.outputs: Markdown artifact plus executive summary and reusable evidence trail.

routing_policy.closeout: Return a short summary and artifact path. Do not bury the only useful output in chat.
routing_policy.default_store: Use the active workspace/artifacts path or the board task's declared artifact path.

capabilities.label: Codex CLI Specialist
capabilities.summary: Use Codex CLI as the fleet-friendly coding specialist when Claude/gstack is unavailable or Codex is the approved host lane.

inputs.goal: Coding, review, QA, or investigation task

capabilities.outputs: Codex run log, status marker, optional proof marker, and closeout summary.
capabilities.rate_limit: Codex subscription limits plus Ralph/durable workload gates

routing_policy.foreground_rule: Small synchronous tasks may use native Hermes terminal execution with notify_on_complete when available.
routing_policy.background_rule: Long-running or detached Codex CLI jobs must use ralph-codex-launch.sh or durable workload job_type=ralph_codex; never raw 'codex ... &' without watchdog registration.

prompt_templates.review: Run Codex in review stance for the diff against base. Return findings first with file/line references, residual risk, and tests not run. Do not edit files unless explicitly asked.
prompt_templates.implementation: Run Codex in an isolated worktree. Implement the requested change, run acceptance checks, and write closeout proof with tests and changed files.
prompt_templates.qa: Run Codex to inspect the app/repo behavior, execute the stated QA checks, record commands/results, and create regression notes for verified bugs.

routing_policy.fallback_rule: If Codex auth or CLI is unavailable, route to another installed coding_agent or escalate with missing capability evidence.
